title: 第13章 出手
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
“十张骷髅小兵总价三千卡恩，按照规定可以赠送一张。这三十张铁剑和一根骨头都不是值钱货，成本加起来也就不到一百卡恩，这样我还能赚二百卡恩的提成……”

    那售卡员盘算了一阵，连忙站起身来，露出一脸笑容。

    “好的客人，就按您的意思。”

    林奇刷卡买单，售卡员恭敬的将十张骷髅小兵和那三十张铁剑，一张骨头卡递了过去，二人都十分满意的完成了交易。

    就在林奇拿起卡片准备回家做实验时，一道跋扈的声音突然响起。

    “呦，这不是我们的废卡天才林奇嘛！你怎么来万卡阁了？难不成你那根狗骨头本命卡，终于能修炼了？啊哈哈哈哈！”

    林奇脚步一顿，扭头看去果然是自己曾经的狗腿子，王猛。

    王猛是他小时候的跟班，以前总跟在他屁股后面“奇哥”长“奇哥”短的叫着，可自从他觉醒了白色品质的器具卡短刀后，就再也没跟他联系过，听说现在已经突破到二星卡徒，在石铁城的年轻卡徒里也算小有名气。

    王猛身边还跟着两个年轻人，都是以前跟他一起玩的跟班，现在却成了王猛的小弟。

    此刻他们正跟着王猛一起嘲笑林奇。

    “哈哈哈，猛哥你说笑了，林奇的本命卡可是一根骨头，骨头要是能修炼，那母猪岂不是能上树了？”

    周围人很快便被这喧哗声吸引，自觉的将目光投了过来，还有人小声议论：“那就是林奇？听说他觉醒了废卡，连卡槽空间都开辟不了……”

    “王猛现在可是二星卡徒，手有两张副卡，林奇怕是要被欺负了。”

    “两个智障。”

    林奇懒得跟他们废话，冷冷地瞥了一眼，转身就要继续走，跟这种人争吵，只会拉低自己的档次。

    “哎呦，大天才别急着走啊！”

    王猛快步上前，伸手就要抓林奇的胳膊。

    “让我看看你买了什么宝贝卡牌，该不会是买了一堆废卡，想回去跟你那根骨头凑一对吧？”

    王猛其实是来万卡阁碰运气，看看能不能淘到便宜的尘星卡，说不定能捡个漏。

    可刚才看到林奇一口气买了几十张卡，哪怕是尘星卡，也得几百卡恩，这可是普通人一个月的收入，他心里顿时不平衡了。

    凭什么一个废卡持有者，能这么有钱？

    “滚开！”

    林奇眼神一冷，还没等他动手，一阵清脆的“叮铃”声突然响起。

    紧接着，一道白影突然窜出，像一道闪电般扑向王猛。

    “喵！喵！”

    风铃猫落在王猛脸上，锋利的爪子瞬间划破了他的皮肤，疯狂地抓挠着，雪白的毛发上很快沾了不少血丝。

    “啊！我的脸！”

    王猛惨叫一声，双手乱挥，想把风铃猫赶下来，可风铃猫动作灵活，不断地在他身上窜跳，怎么都甩不掉。

    周围的人惊呼出声。
content_en:
"The total price of ten skeleton soldiers is 3,000 Karns. According to the regulations, you can give one as a gift. These thirty iron swords and one bone are not valuable goods, and the total cost is less than 100 Karns. In this way, I can still earn a commission of 200 Karns..."

The card seller thought about it for a while, then stood up quickly with a smile on his face.

"Good guest, as you wish."

Lynch swiped his card to pay the bill, and the card seller respectfully handed over the ten skeleton soldiers, the thirty iron swords, and a bone card. Both of them completed the transaction with great satisfaction.

Just when Lynch picked up the card and was about to go home to do the experiment, a domineering voice suddenly sounded.

"Hey, isn't this our useless card genius Lin Qi! Why are you here at Wanka Pavilion? Is it possible that your dog-bone natal card can finally be cultivated? Hahahahaha!"

Lin Qi paused, turned around and saw that it was indeed his former scoundrel, Wang Meng.

Wang Meng was his follower when he was a child. He used to always follow him and call him "Brother Qi", but since he awakened the white quality tool Kadana, he has never contacted him again. I heard that he has now broken through to a two-star Kapu, and is quite famous among the young Kapu in Shitie City.

Wang Meng was accompanied by two young men. They were followers who used to play with him, but now they have become Wang Meng's younger brothers.

At this moment, they were laughing at Lin Qi along with Wang Meng.

"Hahaha, Brother Meng, are you kidding? Lynch's life card is a bone. If the bone can be cultivated, wouldn't the sow be able to climb a tree?"

The people around him were quickly attracted by the noise, and consciously cast their eyes over. Some people whispered: "That's Lynch? I heard that he awakened the waste card and couldn't even open up the card slot space..."

"Wang Meng is now a two-star card disciple and has two secondary cards in his hand. Lin Qi is afraid that he will be bullied."

"Two idiots."

Lin Qi was too lazy to talk nonsense to them. He glanced coldly, turned around and continued walking. Arguing with such people would only lower his own standards.

"Hey, genius, don't leave in a hurry!"

Wang Meng stepped forward quickly and reached out to grab Lin Qi's arm.

"Let me see what precious cards you bought. Could it be that you bought a bunch of useless cards and want to go back and make a pair with your bones?"

Wang Meng actually came to Wanka Pavilion to try his luck and see if he could find cheap Chenxing cards.

But just now he saw that Lin Qi bought dozens of cards in one go. Even the Dust Star card cost hundreds of kahn. This is the monthly income of an ordinary person, and he suddenly felt unbalanced.

How can a scrapped card holder be so rich?

"Get away!"

Lin Qi's eyes turned cold. Before he could take action, a crisp "ding" sound suddenly sounded.

Immediately afterwards, a white shadow suddenly shot out and rushed towards Wang Meng like a bolt of lightning.

"Meow! Meow!"

The wind chime cat landed on Wang Meng's face, its sharp claws instantly scratched his skin, and it scratched frantically. The snow-white hair was quickly stained with blood.

"Ah! My face!"

Wang Meng screamed and waved his hands wildly, trying to drive the wind chime cat off, but the wind chime cat was flexible and kept jumping on him, unable to get rid of it no matter what.

People around him screamed.
